title: Brand Skill repaired-workflow staging preflight rebind

phases.objective: Rebind the governed Staging read-only preflight to the repaired workflow blob while preserving the reviewed runtime and migration snapshot.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A fresh exact authorization comment on Issue #3809 or the bounded main-push fallback
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repaired target workflow is dispatched with the exact runtime commit and migration checksum, the no-apply artifact is independently validated, and the issue is closed only on passing evidence.
steps: Validate the fresh authorization actor and exact token.
Validate the repaired workflow blob on its merge commit and current main.
Validate the migration blob on the runtime commit and current main.
Dispatch the existing Brand Skill MariaDB certification workflow with staging_read_only inputs.
Validate the uploaded artifact and close Issue #3809 only after all no-apply fields pass.
assertions: The new binding identity includes the repaired workflow blob.
The old workflow blob and historical authorization comment ID are rejected by contract tests.
The bridge and fallback contain no staging secrets, migration Apply command, Production environment, or provider mutation.
A completed marker for the exact new binding prevents another completion.
Failed attempts remain fail-closed and do not authorize migration Apply.

phases.objective: Observe the fresh authorized Staging read-only run and validate its artifact.
Keep old workflow blobs, fixed historical authorization IDs, secret access, Apply commands, and Production bindings fail-closed through regression tests.
Execute one checksum and workflow-blob-bound Staging read-only preflight.
This phase grants no migration Apply, deployment, provider, credential, or Production authority.
